title: Admin gets the full list of shipped release notes from GET /releases
preconditions: Signed in as Admin. Frontend source has 40 released versions (3.0.0 baseline … 6.5.0) and 3 planned (6.4.1, 6.4.2, 6.6.0).
expected: 200, code REL_001, data holds every released version, newest first, with its changes (Admin has releases.view_all).
automationHint: request.get /releases; expect data.length > 0 and data[0].version to be the newest released
actualResult: 200 {"code":"REL_001","message":"Release notes fetched successfully.","data":[]} — 0 releases (expected 40). Same on 3 runs today.

title: Employee gets only the release notes for pages an Employee can open
preconditions: Signed in as Employee (only the Employee/Profile pages in the sidebar).
expected: 200 with a non-empty list holding only changes for Employee-visible pages (e.g. profile changes), no admin-only pages.
automationHint: request.get /releases as employee; assert every change.modules is within the employee page set
actualResult: 200, data: [] — nothing at all is returned, so role filtering cannot be checked.

title: EM gets the release notes for the pages an EM can open
expected: 200 with a non-empty, EM-filtered list.

title: Encrypted release content file is published by the frontend build
preconditions: Dev frontend deployed after 26/10 (T1548 code is live: the app calls GET /releases).
steps: Look at the content type and body
expected: A small JSON envelope {v:1, iv, tag, data} (encrypted, unreadable without the key) — the file the backend decrypts.
requirementRef: FE vite.config.ts releaseContentPlugin; BE release-content.service.ts CONTENT_PATH
automationHint: request.get; expect content-type json and keys v/iv/tag/data
actualResult: 200 text/html, 1344 bytes — the SPA index.html fallback. The file was never built, which happens only when RELEASE_CONTENT_KEY is empty in the frontend build (vite.config.ts:48-50). This is the root cause of the empty What's New.

title: Admin can preview planned releases with includePlanned=true
preconditions: Signed in as Admin. 6.4.1, 6.4.2, 6.6.0 are planned in source.
expected: Planned releases are included for Admin.
actualResult: 200, data: [] — no content loaded at all.

title: Non-admin cannot see planned releases even when asking with includePlanned=true
preconditions: Signed in as Employee, then as EM.
expected: 200 with no release whose status is planned.
actualResult: Both 200 with data: []. No planned leak, but with an empty list the rule cannot really be proven.

title: Admin-only changes are not sent to Employee (server-side filtering)
preconditions: Release content loaded on the server.
steps: GET /releases as Admin and as Employee
expected: Employee list is a strict subset of Admin list; no change for admin pages (scheduler, roles) reaches Employee.
actualResult: Both lists are empty.

title: GET /releases without a session returns 401
steps: GET /releases with a fake accessToken cookie
expected: 401 AUTH_001 for all three.
actualResult: All three: 401 {"code":"AUTH_001","message":"Unauthorized access"}.

title: GET /releases is refused after logout
preconditions: Employee signed in, then logged out from the avatar menu.
steps: GET /releases in the same browser context
actualResult: 401 after logout.

title: includePlanned rejects values that are not true/false
expected: 400 VAL_001 with field includePlanned and a readable message.
actualResult: Both 400 {"code":"VAL_001","message":"Validation failed","errors":[{"field":"includePlanned","message":"includePlanned must be a boolean value"}]} for all 3 roles. includePlanned=false → 200.
notes: "1" is also rejected; the app always sends "true", so no impact.

title: Release API is read-only (no detail, no create)
expected: 404 for both; no way to create or change a release through the API.
actualResult: GET /releases/6.6.0 → 404 "Cannot GET /api/v1/releases/6.6.0"; POST /releases → 404 "Cannot POST /api/v1/releases". Same for Employee and EM.

title: releases.read for every role, releases.view_all for Admin only (ability pack)
expected: Admin: {read:[ALL], view_all:[ALL]}. Employee and EM: {read:[ALL]} only.
actualResult: Admin "releases":{"read":["ALL"],"view_all":["ALL"]}; Employee and EM "releases":{"read":["ALL"]}.

title: Roles & Permissions page shows the Releases module with View / View All
expected: Releases section with "View" ticked for every role and "View All" ticked for ADMIN only.
actualResult: Releases → View ticked for EMPLOYEE, RM, TM, EM, ADMIN, PM, PMO…; View All ticked only for ADMIN. Not edited.

title: What's New & History lists release notes for Admin
steps: Click "What's New & History" in the sidebar
expected: Release cards (current release open) with the changes for this role; count shows N releases.
actualResult: Page loads, calls GET /releases?includePlanned=true (200, data []), and shows "0 releases · select a version to see its changes" + "No release notes found".

title: What's New & History lists release notes for Employee
steps: Click "What's New & History" in the sidebar
expected: Release cards (current release open) with the changes for this role; count shows N releases.
actualResult: Page loads, calls GET /releases?includePlanned=true (200, data []), and shows "0 releases · select a version to see its changes" + "No release notes found".

title: What's New & History lists release notes for EM
steps: Click "What's New & History" in the sidebar
expected: Release cards (current release open) with the changes for this role; count shows N releases.
actualResult: Page loads, calls GET /releases?includePlanned=true (200, data []), and shows "0 releases · select a version to see its changes" + "No release notes found".

title: Admin sees the "Preview planned release" toggle
expected: Toggle visible; turning it on shows 6.6.0 etc. marked Planned.
actualResult: Toggle not shown (0 matches) because the API returned no releases.

title: Empty What's New shows a clear "no releases yet" message
preconditions: GET /releases returns [] (current dev state). No search or filter applied.
steps: Open What's New with no filter or search
expected: A message that says there are no releases yet (the app already has the label "No releases yet – Release notes will appear here after the next release.").
actualResult: Shows "No release notes found – Try a different search, page or type of change." and "0 releases · select a version to see its changes" although no search/filter is set. Users are told to change filters that are not the problem.

title: Filters and search behave safely when there is no data
expected: No crash; count stays 0; page filter lists only "All pages".
automationHint: fill search; expect no error boundary
actualResult: No error; "0 releases" + "No release notes found"; page filter options: ["All pages"].

title: Sidebar "What's New & History" entry is present for every role and opens the page
steps: Look at the bottom of the sidebar
expected: Link visible for all roles; page opens at /whats-new and loads from GET /releases (not from the bundle).
actualResult: Link present for Admin, Employee, EM (1 each). Page opens at /whats-new and fires GET /api/v1/releases?includePlanned=true → 200.

title: Release note text is no longer shipped in the JavaScript bundle

testData.probe: Working Location column in employee lists (6.5.0 change title)

steps: Download index.html, the main bundle and all 295 lazy chunks it references
Search them for a release-note title and for ticket ids such as SI4-T1375
expected: No release-note text in any JS file; the bundle only references the /releases endpoint.
requirementRef: FE commit 0d86f73c (no notes in the bundle)
actualResult: 296 JS files scanned: 0 hits for the note title or ticket ids; main bundle contains the "/releases" endpoint.

title: Help & Support shows role-scoped guides for each role
steps: Open Help & Support as each role
Read the "guides for you" and "pages covered" counters
expected: Page loads and counts follow the role (Admin > EM > Employee); not affected by the empty release API.
requirementRef: FE useHelpAccess.ts (view_all instead of role name)
actualResult: Admin 74 guides / 22 pages; EM 49 / 16; Employee 14 / 3. All pages load fully.

title: No bare dash / N-A / null on What's New, Help and the bell for any role
steps: Read every text line on /whats-new, /help and the bell What's New tab
Look for lines that are only a dash or N/A/null
expected: Missing values are readable words.
actualResult: 0 bare tokens on all three screens for all three roles. Empty states use words ("You're up to date", "No release notes found").

title: Bell "What's New" tab falls back to a readable message when no notes load
expected: Readable empty message and a link to the full page; no error, no badge.
actualResult: "You're up to date – New features and fixes for your pages will appear here." + "View What's New & History". No unseen badge.
notes: While content is missing this message is technically misleading, but it is readable; covered by BUG-T1548-01.

title: Existing notifications still show title, body, time and link icon
expected: Items with a body still show the body line (only empty bodies are hidden); unread dot and redirect arrow present.
actualResult: Opportunity "New position …" items show title, 2-line body, time, red unread dot and ↗ link. API: 0 items with empty body for all three users.

title: Bell and tabs have accessible names
steps: Open it and list role=tab items
On /whats-new, read the filter and search names
expected: Bell names the unread count; tabs have names; filters are named comboboxes; page has one h1.
actualResult: Bell aria-label "298 unread notifications"; tabs "Notifications 99+", "What's New"; combobox "Filter by page" and "Filter by type of change", searchbox "Search release notes"; h1 "What's New".

title: Release announcement job is registered and labelled in the Job Scheduler
steps: Open Job Scheduler → Scheduled Jobs → "All Jobs" dropdown
expected: release-announcement listed every 15 minutes; dropdown shows "New Release Notifications".
actualResult: Summary: {"jobName":"release-announcement","cronExpression":"*/15 * * * *","lastRun":null}. Dropdown option "New Release Notifications" present.
notes: lastRun is null: it has never run (see next case).

title: Manual "run now" honours the cron switches and sends nothing while they are off
preconditions: feature.cron.enabled = false (global), feature.cron.releaseAnnouncement.enabled = true on dev.
expected: 202 accepted; job is skipped by the global switch, so no run row and no notification are created.
actualResult: 202 "Cron job triggered; poll the run list for its outcome". After 20 s: 0 runs, no release notification. Unknown job name → 404 "No scheduled job exists with that name".
notes: No cron job has ever run on dev (all 15 have lastRun null) because feature.cron.enabled is false.

title: Only Admin can see or trigger scheduled jobs
preconditions: Signed in as Employee, then EM.
expected: 403 for both roles; nobody but Admin can fire a company-wide announcement.
actualResult: All four calls: 403 {"code":"AUTH_004","message":"Access forbidden"}.

title: In-app notification text is "New release is live – see what’s new" with no body line
preconditions: A new released version exists after the baseline run; release-announcement job has run.
steps: Open the bell after a release is announced
expected: Title exactly "New release is live – see what’s new", empty body, body line not rendered in the bell.
actualResult: No release notification exists for any of the 3 users (eventTypes seen: allocation_ticket.period_cancelled, employee.roles_updated, opportunity.position_added). Job never ran.
notes: Blocked: the job cannot produce a notification on dev. (1) feature.cron.enabled is false, so every run is skipped; (2) even if it ran, it would fail because releases.enc.json is missing (BUG-T1548-01). Turning on the global cron flag would also start 14 other jobs (Zoho sync, allocation changes, etc.), so it was not done.

title: Signed-out user opening /whats-new is sent to login and the page is remembered
expected: Redirect to /login; sessionStorage login_return_to = "/whats-new".
actualResult: URL /login; login_return_to = "/whats-new".

title: After sign-in the user lands on the remembered page (release email link flow)
preconditions: Return-to stored. Microsoft SSO cannot be used with test accounts, so the LoginPage hand-over was exercised by opening /login while the session is active (same code path).
expected: Lands on the remembered page (query kept); key removed after use.
actualResult: /whats-new → landed /whats-new; /help?module=profile → landed /help?module=profile; key null afterwards both times.
notes: The dev-only "Login with Credentials" page (DevLoginPage.tsx:55) does not use the return-to key: after a credentials login the user lands on /profile and the key stays in storage. Dev-only tooling, not reported as a bug.

title: Off-site or loop return-to values are ignored
steps: For each value: set login_return_to, open /login, read final URL
expected: Never leaves simerp-dev; lands on the default page (/profile); key cleared.
actualResult: All four values → https://simerp-dev.simform.solutions/profile; key cleared each time. No open redirect.
